description: This is a PHP source file defining the CustomerTransaction class within the Opencart admin model extension report namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve transaction data and counts from the customer transactions database, with filtering options for date ranges and customer details.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: A model class responsible for retrieving customer transaction data and statistics from the database.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer transactions with optional filters: date range, customer name, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total number of unique customer transactions based on applied filters.
